title: Presentation Spec Generalization
description: Align @framework/presentation with the spec: introduce Slide (arrangement + optional transition), generalize Morph with auto-derived bridge slides, simplify Split to tiles only, remove bespoke column/ghost/morphTarget machinery, update renderer and 33.projektetage deck.
summary: Aligned @framework/presentation with the spec: added Slide (arrangement + per-slide transition), generalized Morph via expandThoughtSlides() auto-inserting bridge slides (source embodiment at target position/style before embodiment switch), simplified Split to tiles-only, added FigureEmbodiment.crop, removed column/ghost/morphTarget machinery. Updated React renderer to iterate expanded slides with per-run autoAnimateId and cropped figure rendering. Re-expressed 33.projektetage deck with column participants (crop figure + text label) and morph bridges focus→labels. Core 28, renderer 17, deck 6 tests pass.
